## This work (Р-218)

The official Russian edition (Hobby World) `osobnyaki-bezumiya-ru` is a scan **without a text layer**; **printed page = physical − 1**. The whole book is already recognised: `.cache/ocr/osobnyaki-bezumiya-ru/NNN.txt` (NNN = physical page, `tesseract -l rus`, 200 dpi). Read that text, and for every number, name and statblock look at the page image (`pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png "<pdf>" <out>` with the pdf path from `pipeline/source/books.json`); OCR garbles letters (ДАЯ = ДЛЯ, Н = М in headings) and digits. Chapter contents (printed pages): 1 «Мистер Корбитт» 11–40, 2 «Скрюченный домище» 41–68, 3 «Секретный код» 69–102, 4 «Дом Мемфиса» 103–142, 5 «Девятнадцатая лунка» 143–181; «Материалы для игроков» 182–219 (handouts and player maps of all five scenarios — take only those of your scenario; the heading of each handout names it); index 220–224. Official Russian handout file for «Дом Мемфиса»: `…\Особняки безумия (Mansions of Madness)\Раздатка\[RU 7e] 1927 Дом Мемфиса раздатка.pdf`. The English book in the same folder is the 6e edition — not a source of numbers; use it only to be sure of `name.en`. The pre-generated investigators of the collection already exist in `kb/books/za-zakrytymi-dveryami-ru/` (book `za-zakrytymi-dveryami-pregens-ru`) — link them from the scenario, never duplicate. Model of a scanned official Russian scenario: `kb/books/dveri-vo-tmu-ru/scenarios/darkness-beneath-the-hill.json` and its report `checks/20261112-doors-darkness-hill/darkness.md`. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- Russian text: as printed (official; no `translated`); English names in `name.en` only if certain.
- Records — book-scoped `osobnyaki-bezumiya-ru/<kind>/<unit>-<slug>` in `kb/books/osobnyaki-bezumiya-ru/<kinds>/` (file names start with your unit name, e.g. `corbitt-house.json`): scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, tomes, spells new to the base (draft them in your report — `kb/spells` is shared), organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. Cities — shared records (Р-190): Boston `coc:location:boston` is created by the lead and exists when you start — never rewrite it, add refs through proposals; new cities listed in your unit's `owns` are yours to create. The scenario's places are book records `part_of` the city, places outside a city under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/mansions-<unit>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209).
- `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35).
- Coverage: `checks/20261111-mansions/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
